examples.text: ko rājaputtaṃ nisabhaṃ, jayantam'aparājitaṃ, bhaye khemassa dātāraṃ, ko me vessantaraṃ vidū.

28001.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha

examples.text: jeto jayanto padumo uppalo ca, padum'uttaro rakkhito pabbato ca, mānatthaddho sobhito vītarāgo, kaṇho ca buddho suvimuttacitto.

examples.text: jayaṃ veraṃ pasavati, dukkhaṃ seti parājito, upasanto sukhaṃ seti, hitvā jayaparājayaṃ.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, dve jayampatikā parittaṃ sambalaṃ ādāya kantāramaggaṃ paṭipajjeyyuṃ
evaṃ vutte, jayaseno rājakumāro aciravataṃ samaṇ'uddesaṃ etadavoca, aṭṭhānam'etaṃ, bho aggivessana, anavakāso yaṃ bhikkhu appamatto ātāpī pahit'atto viharanto phuseyya cittassa ek'aggatan'ti.

28008.commentary: (DNa) jay'āpekkho'ti jayapurekkhāro hutvā, yathā hatthako sakyaputto titthiyā nāma dhammena'pi adhammena'pi jetabbā'ti sacc'ālikaṃ yaṃkiñci bhāsati, evaṃ jay'āpekkho jayapurekkhāro hutvā na bhāsatī'ti attho.

examples.text: idha, bhante, ekacco na c'eva musāvād'upasañhitaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati na ca vebhūtiyaṃ na ca pesuṇiyaṃ na ca sārambhajaṃ jay'āpekkho, mantā mantā ca vācaṃ bhāsati nidhānavatiṃ kālena. etadānuttariyaṃ, bhante, bhassasamācāre.

ye kec'ime isayo manujā, khattiyā brāhmaṇā devatānaṃ, yaññam'akappayiṃsu puthū'dha loke, kacci'ssu te bhagavā yaññapathe appamattā, atāruṃ jātiñ'ca jarañ'ca mārisa, pucchāmi taṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ.
yaṃ taṃ apucchimha akittayī no, aññaṃ taṃ pucchāma tadiṅgha brūhi, kathaṃ nu dhīrā vitaranti oghaṃ, jātiṃ jaraṃ sokapariddavañ'ca, taṃ me muni sādhu viyākarohi, tathā hi te vidito esa dhammo.

28015.commentary: (PVa) jaraggavan'ti balibaddaṃ jiṇṇagoṇaṃ. (THa) paṅkamhi'va jaraggavo mahākaddamakucchiyaṃ sampatitadubbalabalibaddo viya byasanam'eva pāpuṇantī'ti attho.

examples.text: evam'etaṃ mahāvīra, yathā samaṇa bhāsasi, ettha c'eke visīdanti, paṅkamhi'va jaraggavo.
taṃ taṃ gāmapati brūmi, kadare appasmi jīvite, dve māse saṅgaraṃ katvā, maṃsaṃ jaraggavaṃ kisaṃ.

examples.text: te jātisaṃvattanikesu saṅkhāresu abhiramanti … abhiratā … abhisaṅkharonti … abhisaṅkharitvā jāt'andhakāram'pi papatanti, jar'andhakāram'pi papatanti maraṇ'andhakāram'pi papatanti, soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyās'andhakāram'pi papatanti.

28018.notes: Mano-group nouns, while neuter in Sanskrit, are considered to be masculine by classical Pāḷi grammars such as Saddanīti. The example given is mano anicco, mano dukkho'ti. Counter-examples are amoghaṃ tapo and paramaṃ tapo.

examples.text: taṇh'ādhipanne manuje pekkhamāno, santāpajāte jarasā parete, tasmā tuvaṃ piṅgiya appamatto, jahassu taṇhaṃ apunabbhavāyā'ti.
appaṃ vata jīvitaṃ idaṃ, oraṃ vassasatā'pi miyyati, yo ce'pi aticca jīvati, atha kho so jarasā'pi miyyati.
seyyathā'pi, ānanda, jarasakaṭaṃ veḷamissakena yāpeti, evam'eva kho, ānanda, vedhamissakena maññe tathāgatassa kāyo yāpeti.

atha te, jarasakko amhe matte katvā mahāsamuddapiṭṭhe khipitvā amhākaṃ devanagaraṃ gaṇhi, te mayaṃ tena saddhiṃ yujjhitvā amhākaṃ devanagaram'eva gaṇhissāmā'ti kipillikā viya thambhaṃ sineruṃ anusañcaramānā uṭṭhahiṃsu.

appaṃ vata jīvitaṃ idaṃ, oraṃ vassasatā'pi miyyati, yo ce'pi aticca jīvati, atha kho so jarasā'pi miyyati.

tass'eva kho, āvuso pāthikaputta, sīhassa migarañño vighāsasaṃvaḍḍho jarasigālo ditto c'eva balavā ca.

28041.meaning1: peril of old age; danger of ageing
28041.commentary: (ANa) jarābhayan'ti jaraṃ paṭicca uppajjanakabhayaṃ. itaresu'pi es'eva nayo. vuttam'pi c'etaṃ, jaraṃ paṭicca uppajjati bhayaṃ bhayānakaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃso cetaso utrāso. byādhiṃ paṭicca, maraṇaṃ paṭicca uppajjati bhayaṃ bhayānakaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃso cetaso utrāso'ti (vibha. 921).

examples.text: katamāni tīṇi? jarābhayaṃ, byādhibhayaṃ, maraṇabhayan'ti. na, bhikkhave, mātā puttaṃ jīramānaṃ evaṃ labhati, ahaṃ jīrāmi, mā me putto jīrī'ti, putto vā pana mātaraṃ jīramānaṃ na evaṃ labhati, ahaṃ jīrāmi, mā me mātā jīrī'ti.

tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave etadahosi, kimhi nu kho sati jarāmaraṇaṃ hoti kiṃpaccayā jarāmaraṇan'ti
